Optimized `src/analytics.ts`:

1. **`getEventsForUser`** — Replaced the O(n²) nested-loop implementation with a single `events.filter(...)` call, now O(n). Added comment: `O(n^2) before (nested loop) → O(n) after (single filter pass)`.

2. **`getSummaryByType`** — Replaced the per-type `filter` + `reduce` (O(n·t)) with a single accumulation pass over all events, followed by one O(t) pass over the distinct types to compute averages. Total is now O(n + t). Added comment: `O(n * t) before (filter + reduce per type) → O(n) after (single pass + O(t) avg pass)`.

3. Both functions now have complexity-before/after comments directly above them.
